item.description:
### Added - **Droid: Allow or Deny a permission from your phone, watch or Mac notification.** For a Droid session running in tmux, a command or file edit that needs your OK now comes with Allow and Deny buttons, like Claude's. Before pressing anything, Perch checks the terminal: the dialog must still be up, with the same command or file you were shown. If it isn't, nothing is pressed and the prompt stays for you at the terminal. Two tools at once, and "always allow", are left to the terminal. - **Droid edits made with patches now show the file name** on the row.
### Fixed - **A session waiting on a permission always gets a Mac alert now.** With approval notifications on, Perch skipped the "needs you" alert and expected an Allow/Deny one instead. For Amp, Antigravity, Cursor, Devin and Droid outside tmux no Allow/Deny one ever came, so there was no alert at all. They now get "needs you", and the agents that do get Allow/Deny don't get both.
